description:
A TikTok sound by URL or ID: title, artist, duration, original-sound flag, cover, audio URL and how many videos use it, plus the top videos using it (max 12, from the public embed).
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: id (string), title (string, nullable), author (string, nullable), album (string, nullable), duration (integer, nullable), is_original (boolean, nullable), cover_url (string, nullable), play_url (string, nullable), video_count (integer, nullable), link (string), videos (array<object>), videos_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return. Example: 12

name: tiktok_music
title: TikTok sound
